title: Handoff field su Phase + operazioni PlanStore core
summary: Aggiungere handoff:string su PhaseSchema + ops listHandoffs/getPhaseHandoff/setPhaseHandoff/clearPhaseHandoff (core-only, harness-agnostic).
description:
Aggiungere il campo handoff sull'entità Fase e le operazioni CRUD core (harness-agnostic).

## Stato attuale (codice)
- `PhaseSchema` (packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts:183) **non ha** `handoff`. L'handoff è file-based (`PlanStore.loadHandoff()`/`handoffPath()` → `.planner/HANDOFF.md`).
- Phase ha già `taskIds` + `tasks` embeddati, `updatedAt` (TimestampSchema).

## Work items
1. Aggiungere a `PhaseSchema`: `handoff: z.string().default("")` e `handoffUpdatedAt: z.string().default("")` (ISO timestamp). Backfill automatico via default zod sui phase file esistenti.
2. PlanStore (plan-store.ts) — operazioni **core-only**:
   - `listHandoffs(): Promise<Array<{phaseId, compositeRef, updatedAt, firstLine}>>` — scansiona `loadAllPhases()`, filtra `handoff` non-vuoto, restituisce compositeRef `P00x(F00x)` + `handoffUpdatedAt` + prima riga (prime ~80 char).
   - `getPhaseHandoff(phaseId): Promise<string>` — load phase, return `handoff`.
   - `setPhaseHandoff(phaseId, text): Promise<void>` — atomic update phase file: set `handoff` + `handoffUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString()`.
   - `clearPhaseHandoff(phaseId): Promise<void>` — set `handoff=""`, `handoffUpdatedAt` opzionale (lascia o azzera).
3. Le op devono usare `atomicUpdateJson(phasePath)` (per-file lock), non riscrivere tutto.

## Rischi
- Performance `listHandoffs`: readdir phases + load each — equivalente a `loadAllPhases()` (già usato), accettabile.
- Schema migration: zod default gestisce il nuovo campo sui vecchi file (nessuna migrazione esplicita richiesta).

## Comportamenti da preservare
- `PhaseSchema` backward compat (campo nuovo con default).
- Operazioni core esportate da `@agent-plan/core` (non dal adapter) per riuso Pi/MCP/futuri.

`PhaseSchema` (plan-core/src/schema.ts:183) non ha `handoff`. Phase ha `updatedAt` (TimestampSchema).

tasks.title: PlanStore ops: listHandoffs/getPhaseHandoff/setPhaseHandoff/clearPhaseHandoff
tasks.description:
**P2 — handoff ops core (harness-agnostic).**

## Da fare in plan-core/plan-store.ts
1. `listHandoffs(): Promise<Array<{phaseId: string, compositeRef: string, updatedAt: string, firstLine: string}>>` — `loadAllPhases()` → filtra `handoff` non-vuoto → compositeRef `P00x(F00x)` (usare helper esistente di composizione ID) + `handoffUpdatedAt` + prima riga (prime ~80 char, senza markdown header).
2. `getPhaseHandoff(phaseId): Promise<string>` — `loadPhase` → return `phase.handoff`.
3. `setPhaseHandoff(phaseId, text): Promise<void>` — `atomicUpdateJson(phasePath(phaseId), PhaseSchema, p => ({...p, handoff: text, handoffUpdatedAt: new Date().toISOString()}))` (per-file lock).
4. `clearPhaseHandoff(phaseId): Promise<void>` — set `handoff=""` (lascia `handoffUpdatedAt` o azzerarlo: decidere; preferibile azzerare per distinguere "mai avuto" — ma utile tenere per audit; opt: lasciare handoffUpdatedAt).

## Edge case
- `listHandoffs` phase non validi → skip.
- compositeRef: fase senza featureId → `P00x` senza `(F00x)`.

---
**Completion summary:**
Done. Added formatPhaseRef(phaseNumber, featureNumber?) to packages/plan-core/src/naming.ts (→ "P00x" or "P00x(F00x)", reuses formatThreeDigitNumber). Added to plan-store.ts: export interface PhaseHandoffSummary {phaseId, compositeRef, updatedAt, firstLine}; module helper handoffFirstLine() (first non-empty line, leading # stripped, ~80 chars); 4 ops — getPhaseHandoff (loadPhase.handoff), setPhaseHandoff/clearPhaseHandoff (via updatePhase → atomicUpdateJson per-file lock + maybeAutoSync; clear leaves handoffUpdatedAt as audit trail per decision), listHandoffs (loadAllPhases + loadFeatures featureId→number map, filter non-empty, sort handoffUpdatedAt desc). Also added handoff:""+handoffUpdatedAt:"" to 4 Phase object literals (plan-mcp:454, plan-server:404, pi-adapter:1681+2968) for schema-compat (zod default makes output type require the field). pnpm -r build + pnpm check clean; smoke test OK (set→get, P001/P002(F001) refs, header-strip, sort desc, clear-audit, missing→throw).
